headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Cutting-Edge Features
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and risk assessment tools to improve ClearInstall's local-first lockfile auditing. Leverage AI-driven insights for enhanced security checks, and incorporate advanced binding.gyp command expansion visibility.
actions: Implement real-time dependency analysis to detect potential vulnerabilities before installation
Utilize AI-driven risk assessments to provide users with detailed explanations of install-time risks
Add support for advanced binding.gyp command expansion visibility to ensure safe execution
